description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `letterGrade(score)` koja broj poena (0 do 100) pretvara u ocenu slovom:

- 90 i više: `'A'`
- 80 do 89: `'B'`
- 70 do 79: `'C'`
- 60 do 69: `'D'`
- manje od 60: `'F'`

Primeri:
- `letterGrade(95)` → `'A'`
- `letterGrade(85)` → `'B'`
- `letterGrade(50)` → `'F'`
description.en:
Write a function `letterGrade(score)` that converts a number of points (0 to 100) into a letter grade:

- 90 and more: `'A'`
- 80 to 89: `'B'`
- 70 to 79: `'C'`
- 60 to 69: `'D'`
- less than 60: `'F'`

Examples:
- `letterGrade(95)` → `'A'`
- `letterGrade(85)` → `'B'`
- `letterGrade(50)` → `'F'`

label.sr: lanac uslova od najvišeg ka najnižem
label.en: a chain of conditions from the highest to the lowest

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function letterGrade` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(score)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: kad pozovemo `letterGrade(85)`, unutar funkcije je `score` jednako `85`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 7.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function letterGrade` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(score)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: when we call `letterGrade(85)`, inside the function `score` equals `85`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 7 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Prvo proveravamo najvišu ocenu.

- `if (uslov) naredba` izvršava naredbu samo ako je uslov `true`.
- `score >= 90` pita: da li je `score` veći od ili jednak 90? Operator `>=` uključuje i samu granicu, pa 90 dobija `'A'`.
- `return 'A'` vraća tekst `'A'` i odmah završava funkciju, pa se ostale provere ne izvršavaju.
text.en:
First we check the highest grade.

- `if (condition) statement` runs the statement only if the condition is `true`.
- `score >= 90` asks: is `score` greater than or equal to 90? The `>=` operator includes the boundary itself, so 90 gets `'A'`.
- `return 'A'` returns the text `'A'` and ends the function immediately, so the other checks do not run.

text.sr:
Zatim ocena `'B'`.

- Do ove linije stižu samo brojevi manji od 90, jer su ostali već izašli u liniji 2. Zato je dovoljno proveriti samo donju granicu: `score >= 80`.
- Ne treba pisati `score >= 80 && score < 90`: gornja granica je već pokrivena redosledom provera.
text.en:
Then the grade `'B'`.

- Only numbers below 90 reach this line, because the others already left on line 2. So it is enough to check only the lower bound: `score >= 80`.
- There is no need to write `score >= 80 && score < 90`: the upper bound is already covered by the order of the checks.

text.sr: Isto za `'C'`: stižu samo brojevi manji od 80, pa proveravamo samo `score >= 70`.
text.en: The same for `'C'`: only numbers below 80 arrive, so we check only `score >= 70`.

text.sr: Isto za `'D'`: stižu samo brojevi manji od 70, pa proveravamo samo `score >= 60`.
text.en: The same for `'D'`: only numbers below 70 arrive, so we check only `score >= 60`.

text.sr:
Sve što je preostalo je `'F'`.

- Ovde nema uslova: do ove linije stižu samo brojevi manji od 60.
- Zato nije potreban ni `else`: svaki `if` iznad završava funkciju svojim `return`-om, pa preostali kod nikad ne stiže do linije 6 ako je neki uslov tačan.

Tok za nekoliko vrednosti:

```
score = 95 → 95 >= 90? da → 'A'
score = 85 → 85 >= 90? ne → 85 >= 80? da → 'B'
score = 60 → 60 >= 90? ne → >= 80? ne → >= 70? ne → 60 >= 60? da → 'D'
score = 59 → sve provere ne → 'F'
```
text.en:
Whatever is left is `'F'`.

- There is no condition here: only numbers below 60 reach this line.
- That is why `else` is not needed either: every `if` above ends the function with its own `return`, so the remaining code never reaches line 6 if some condition is true.

Flow for several values:

```
score = 95 → 95 >= 90? yes → 'A'
score = 85 → 85 >= 90? no → 85 >= 80? yes → 'B'
score = 60 → 60 >= 90? no → >= 80? no → >= 70? no → 60 >= 60? yes → 'D'
score = 59 → all checks no → 'F'
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Redosled provera (od najviše granice ka najnižoj) čini gornje granice nepotrebnim.
note.en: The order of the checks (from the highest bound to the lowest) makes the upper bounds unnecessary.
